definitions.explanation: The specific model or type of a vehicle. Used when talking about choosing, comparing, or identifying different cars.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{車種|しゃしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦レンタカー→レンタカー：23193_rentakaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{車種|しゃしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please choose the type of rental car.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{車種|しゃしゅ}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: Insurance premiums vary greatly depending on the car model.

notes:
{車種|しゃしゅ} refers to the model or type of a vehicle. It covers both specific models (e.g., a particular car name) and broader categories (sedan, SUV, compact).

FORMS:
⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle) + ⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧ (type, kind)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {車種|しゃしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose a car model
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧{車種|しゃしゅ}: popular car model
- ⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧{車種|しゃしゅ}: applicable vehicle types
- {車種|しゃしゅ}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧: varies by vehicle type

USAGE:
In rental car and insurance contexts, {車種|しゃしゅ} often refers to size class (compact, sedan, SUV) rather than a specific brand or model name.

- ⟦{品種|ひんしゅ}→品種：11840_hinshu⟧: variety, breed
- ⟦{機種|きしゅ}→機種：13211_kishu⟧: device model (phones, computers)
